title: Finding the way in the Tempest
summary: Direction and travel in the storm between realms.

claims.text: The Tempest is the endless storm-ocean dividing the realms of the dead; once a calm sea that Ferrymen crossed in reed boats, it changed for reasons no one now remembers.
Direction and distance there are partly subjective, but places everyone agrees on can be reached along shared byways that work like highways or sea lanes.

Travelers use roads, bridges, rail lines and waterways; Ferryman reed boats survive the worst storms, Stygia runs ships of Stygian metal and great railroads, and some wraiths own relic vehicles from chariots to motorcycles.

title: The River of Death
summary: The great channel through the Tempest.

claims.text: The River of Death was once the main path for souls going down into the Underworld; legends call it the Lady of Fate's tears, or the tears shed by and for the dead.
Charon sailed it in a reed boat woven by the Lady of Fate and found at its delta the Sunless Sea and the Isle of Sorrows, where Stygia was built.
It is the one byway the Tempest never cuts, and along it small communities of Renegades and Heretics too strange for their own sects hide in coves and islands.

title: Grotesques
summary: Vast hungry Malfeans of the Tempest.

claims.text: Grotesques are Malfeans grown huge and ever hungrier, attacking anything in their territory, sometimes trailed by Shades and served by lesser Malfeans for a share of the spoils.
The reptilian Grotesque Gorool threatened Stygia in the Fifth Great Maelstrom, wrecking much of its fleet until Charon drew it away and both sank in a whirlpool; whether either survived is unknown.
Tempest gypsies shift their mobile Haunts between the Shadowlands and the Tempest and enjoy the comforts of a Haunt wherever they go, using an art they refuse to teach.
Most wraiths leave them alone out of fear of their powers.
